purpose: Test whether the declared past collar with integrated clocks removes the earlier conditional-record blindness; this is an auxiliary instrument, not a physical mass or geometry experiment.

history_family.construction: Take transitive closures and then every distinct image under G=S2(A) x S2(R), transporting all fields and boundary packets.
history_family.measure_status: Explicit auxiliary labelled counting convention; not a derivation of a physical CST history measure. Class weights are amplitude priors, not record probabilities.

action.scalar: S_phi=1/2 q^T H_C q, H_C=-beta/2 D_inc^T diag(b) D_inc
action.scope: Original action formula on the explicitly new six-history family; the earlier AA33 block and its sign bound are not substituted.

measures.clock: d_lambda(t)=1_[-1,1] dt/2 at all six nodes, identical constant clock packets
measures.density: d_nu(r)=delta_0/2+1_(0,1)dr/2 at all six nodes, with no removal of the atom
measures.sewing_convention: Use action/influence factors without extra local quotient prefactors; integrate the global mu_P mu_A mu_R mu_I exactly once. No inherited factor 2. At S=A union {3}, use mu_S=mu_A mu_I.
measures.qualification: A declared quotient and normalization convention, not a physical derivation of the inner product.

packets.P: sqrt(2)*1_(r0=0)*pi^(-1/4)*exp(-q0^2/2), constant clock packet; unit norm in mu_P
packets.A_Psi_s: sqrt(2)*d_s*A_h0, constant clock packet; unit norm in mu_A
packets.held_out_input_gplus: P packet tensor A_Psi_plus, fixed before integrated amplitude calculation
packets.input_orthogonality: g0 and gplus are orthonormal through disjoint A-density strata
packets.R_f: sqrt(2)*(2*1_(r4=r5=0))*pi^(-1/2)*exp[-(q4^2+q5^2)/2], constant clock packet; unit norm in mu_R

clock_reduction.t4_t5: Their normalized integrals equal 1 because the terminal density packet is atomic and the scalar action is clock independent.
clock_reduction.E: E(k)=integral_0^1 exp(-i*k*r)dr, with removable value E(0)=1
clock_reduction.kappa_A_i: 1/2+beta/4*(ti-t0)^2, i=1,2, identical in all six histories
clock_reduction.joint_preparation_rewrite: The common past dust phase U_P=exp[-i sum_(i=1,2)kappa_A_i(T)*r_i] generates density-clock correlations under the same original action. It is independent of the future class. Absorbing it into a joint input is an exact rewrite, never a second insertion or a freely selected class-dependent prior. It is not a calibrated physical source preparation.
clock_reduction.fixed_clock_control: For any fixed common t0,t1,t2, R is constant across all future histories and records: a_j(gplus)=R*a_j(g0), even if t3 remains integrated. At t0=t1=t2=0, R=(2E(1/2)+E(1/2)^2)/sqrt(3). This is an algebraic control, not a normalized delta-clock state in the original Hilbert space.

records.coherence: Sum label-equivalent histories coherently within a class. Distinct record classes and inner strata have separate ideal apparatus flags.
records.extra_apparatus_assumption: Ideal hypothetical recordability of the order class and inner density stratum, orthogonal flags, terminal packet f postselection, fixed acceptance gain. No derivation of a physical geometric detector or environmental decoherence is claimed.
records.preparation_space: E=span(g0,gplus) with the declared kinematic norm
records.failure_map: M_F=(I_E-sum_j M_j^dagger M_j)^(1/2), with its own failure flag
records.probability_rule: q_j(g)=|a_j(g)|^2, Z(g)=sum_j q_j(g); P(j|success,g)=q_j/Z if Z>0; P(success,g)=gain^2 Z; P(failure,g)=1-gain^2 Z
records.direct_contrast: X_j=q_j(g0)*Z(gplus)-q_j(gplus)*Z(g0); certify Z>0 and compare each X_j with zero. Also report geometry-class marginal contrast and every failure probability.
records.no_global_adjoint_product: All Kraus effects live on E. No undefined global K^dagger K on the full original boundary Hilbert space is used.

uniform_instrument_bound_before_results.input_V_norm_squared: 2257/16 for either input; same multiplier times the E-norm on their orthogonal span
uniform_instrument_bound_before_results.selection: Gain fixed from this analytic uniform bound, not fitted to numerical amplitudes.

source_constraint_qualification.A_constraints: C_i=1+beta/2*(ti-t0)^2>=1 for i=1,2 in every history
source_constraint_qualification.positive_free_A_stationary_source: IMPOSSIBLE if A densities are freely varied positive interior variables
source_constraint_qualification.declared_role_of_A: Prepared fixed boundary coordinates / off-shell integrated quantum test packets, not an on-shell solved positive source
source_constraint_qualification.past_and_terminal_atoms: Retained exactly by boundary packets; not identified with the positive stationary branch

decision_rules.nonzero_contrast: Only a controlled finite auxiliary record response; no physical mass backreaction claim
decision_rules.all_contrasts_exactly_zero: Negative result for this frozen record/preparation contrast
decision_rules.interval_contains_zero: Unresolved, not a proof of zero
decision_rules.no_posthoc_replacement: Do not change weights, packets, record resolution, gain, or final filter to obtain a desired sign.
